verdict.rationale: Mercury's own materials say you can instantly spin up as many virtual cards as you need for any purpose, including ad spend and contractors, and govern them with card limits and spend controls. The Cards API can also issue virtual cards and manage spending limits programmatically. A 5-year customer independently reports creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. missing for 10: explicit evidence of merchant/vendor-locking so a card works only with a single vendor, documentation of which spend-control types exist beyond limits
